String.string:
[EN] [Solo] Time Distortions
[ES] [Solo] Distorsiones temporales
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll get back to Meren now."
[ES] "Volveré con Meren ahora."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Seir at Velika Headquarters.
[ES] Encuentra a Seir en el cuartel general de Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain the Teleport Scroll.
[ES] Consigue el pergamino de teletransporte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Meren in Velika Headquarters and check the lost and found.
[ES] Ve con Meren al cuartel general de Velika y revisa la sección de objetos perdidos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use Personal Teleport Scroll: Jovin to teleport to Arun Heights. [Press to open your inventory and select Personal Teleport Scroll: Jovin.]
[ES] Usa el pergamino de teletransporte personal: Jovin para teletransportarte a Arun Heights. [Presiona para abrir tu inventario y seleccionar el pergamino de teletransporte personal: Jovin.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "On my way!"
[ES] ¡Allá voy!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Show the pendant to Jovin.
[ES] Muéstrale el colgante a Jovin.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Absorbing the Corrupted Mana
[ES] Absorbiendo el maná corrupto
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Brutal Naga Battlemaster, Brutal Iron Giant, and Brutal Onyx Hydrath to charge the Dimension Stabilizer.
[ES] Derrota al maestro de batalla naga brutal, al gigante de hierro brutal y al hidrath de ónix brutal para cargar el estabilizador dimensional.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "On my way!"
[ES] ¡Allá voy!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Remove the time distortions.
[Press F near the Time Distortions.]
[ES] Elimina las distorsiones temporales.
[Presiona F cerca de las distorsiones temporales.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Meren.
[ES] Informa a Meren.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Jovin in the Arun Heights.
[ES] Regresa con Jovin a Arun Heights.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Claim reward.
[ES] Reclama la recompensa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tell Meren you could not find the pendant's owner.
[ES] Dile a Meren que no pudiste encontrar al dueño del colgante.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
